dataset_split_policy.rule: All clips sharing the same UCF gXX group must remain in the same dataset role to prevent near-duplicate/source leakage.
dataset_split_policy.future_assignment: A newly verified clip inherits its existing gXX role. A new gXX group is assigned as a whole while keeping approximate TRAIN/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT balance.

user_original_group_policy.reason: The three verified STANDARD clips are distinct canonical videos and distinct capture sessions, but stored provenance does not establish reporter/person independence. Keep them in one split to prevent possible source/session/person leakage.

dataset_split_policy.source_partition_note: UCF source train/val/test folder names are provenance only. Research TRAIN/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT roles are assigned at whole gXX-group level to prevent same-source/person-group leakage and may override source-folder partitions.
dataset_split_policy.role_provenance_note: The final group-locked research split is authoritative. current_ucf_groups must exactly match item.dataset_role for every UCF gXX group.
